_what: Fusion comparison on Ice overhang, shade: the full COLMAP pipeline against TSDF fusion of FoundationStereo and of tuned-SGBM depth, all three on the same COLMAP poses and frames, tags masked. No CAD model for ice, so the comparison is top-down coverage over the ice region (evaluation.region, picked by Glen from topdown.png) and the figures.

recording.name: ice_overhang_shade_hang1
recording.title: Ice overhang, shade
recording._inputs: Made by reproduce.py fusion_ice (pose_fusion_inputs): every frame, tags masked.

_frame_step: Every 2nd posed frame for all three methods (Glen, 17 Oct): halves COLMAP's ~40 s per image.

methods.name: colmap
methods.label: COLMAP (full pipeline)
methods.mode: PatchMatch MVS with geometric consistency on the SfM model the COLMAP poses come from, then stereo_fusion; the tag masks (undistorted with the images) drop tag pixels from the fusion.

methods.name: tsdf_fs
methods.label: TSDF, FoundationStereo
methods.mode: tsdf_fuse.py on depth_frames.py FoundationStereo depth (ViT-L, net scale 0.5, left-right check 3 px, tags masked) at the COLMAP poses.

methods.name: tsdf_sgbm
methods.label: TSDF, SGBM (tuned)
methods.mode: tsdf_fuse.py on depth_frames.py tuned-SGBM depth (block 11, uniqueness 0, P1/P2 16/32, half resolution, tags masked) at the COLMAP poses.

colmap._why: colmap_mvs.py's defaults, which were set on the Sep24/Sep30 lab scans (see its comments).
colmap._keep_depth_maps: false: once fused, the depth maps are deleted (disk), after a preview of the images at preview_fractions of the frames used is saved.
colmap._cache_gb: 4, not colmap_mvs.py's 12: on 17 Oct stereo_fusion on S30 (688 images, 25.9 M points) reached 25.8 GB with a 12 GB cache and was killed for lack of memory at its last step. The cache only sets how many depth maps stay in RAM; it does not change the fused cloud.
colmap._fusion_max_image_size: Stereo fusion samples the (full-size) depth maps down to 1000 px: on 18 Oct S30's full-size fusion reached 22 GB at image 479 of 688 (17.5 M points, ~1.3 KB each; all 688 would need ~30 GB, the whole laptop). At 1000 px points are still ~0.5 mm apart on the board, finer than TSDF's 1 mm voxels and the 1 mm scoring cells. Same for every recording so they are treated alike.

tsdf._why: tsdf_fuse.py's defaults: 1 mm voxels, truncation 4 mm (above the ~4 mm view-dependent disagreement found on Oct1), surface kept where >= 3 frames contributed (the counterpart of voxel voting's --min-views 3). Memory cap: the first uncapped trial ran the laptop out of memory.

evaluation._align: One rigid fit of the COLMAP trajectory onto the tag poses over every frame both posed: camera centres plus a point align_lever_mm along each camera axis, as in the pose comparison (a straight pass leaves the roll about the track free otherwise).
evaluation._objects: No CAD model for the ice.
evaluation._report: What the table and figures show: compare_to_cad.py's on_local_board fit (the object's own error, with the board levelled around it), for the objects listed. The egg blocks are left out for now: their CAD fit locks onto a wrong rotation, and EGG_2PKS's STL is unconfirmed.
evaluation._height_range_mm: null: the colour range of the figures is set from the clouds (2nd-98th percentile).
evaluation._region: The ice, in the board frame: [x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max] mm, picked by Glen from topdown.png after the run (the tags are on a separate object, so the tag area is not the ice). null until then.
evaluation._coverage: Top-down coverage (Glen, 17 Oct): % of the region's coverage_cell_mm cells with at least one point.
evaluation._region_set: Picked on 19 Oct from topdown.png: the overhang's ice plate with ~25 mm margin, right of the tag plate.
